newsitem.title: USA: Emergent plans to sell auto lending unit.
newsitem.headline: Emergent plans to sell auto lending unit.

text.p: Emergent Group Inc said Monday it plans to divest its auto lending division and expects to determine within 90 days the feasibility of completing a sale this year on acceptable terms.

"We are divesting our auto loan division because it is such a small portion of our overall operations and we believe it is in our best interest to concentrate on the faster growing segments of our business," said Jack Sterling, chairman and chief executive officer.
Emergent's auto loan division makes direct loans primarily to non-prime borrowers for the purchase of used automobiles through eight retail offices in South Carolina.
The company said the division originated $18 million in loans in 1996, or about four percent of Emergent's total loan originations for that year.
For the first half of 1997 the division originated $8 million in loans, the diverfisied financial services company said.
